title: Uniruled Fourfolds in Lean 4: A Conditional Cycle-Class Reduction under Four Named Hypotheses (L11), (BS), (CL), (U)
description: Lean 4 development (UniruledFourfolds/Blueprint.lean, UniruledFourfolds/NonVacuity.lean, UniruledFourfolds/Semantics.lean, UniruledFourfolds/MukaiLattice.lean) of a conditional cycle-class reduction for smooth complex projective fourfolds, with no sorry and no axiom. Kernel-checked: if a correspondence from a threefold satisfies (BS) a Bloch–Srinivas decomposition on Hodge classes and (CL) compatibility with the cycle class map, and (L11) the Lefschetz (1,1) theorem holds on the threefold, then the codimension-2 cycle class map is surjective onto rational Hodge classes; under (U) this holds for every uniruled fourfold. Finite models show the four hypotheses are jointly consistent and that none can be dropped. (L11), (BS), (CL) and (U) are open assumptions, not theorems of the development; the cohomology groups, Chow groups and cycle class maps are uninterpreted placeholders. No case of the Hodge conjecture is proven. MukaiLattice.lean checks integer identities about a quadratic form and does not bear on cycle-class surjectivity.
